Name: Fast Farm Fabrications - Construct Upgraded Buildings Directly
Author: zombifier
Description:
Have the resources to directly build a Deluxe Coop/Barn/other upgrades but don't feel like going back to Robin 3 times in a row? This mod allows you to tell Robin to skip the upgrade process and build them directly from scratch, with the appropriate costs and days! Simply press the button labeled "Toggle Direct Build" to toggle between upgrade mode or direct build mode (see screenshots for info).

There are two config modes, toggleable in Generic Mod Config Menu or config.json:[list]
[*]Vanilla: The same time and resources as upgrading a building incrementally (e.g a Deluxe Barn costs 43,000g, 1350 Wood, 650 Stone, and 7 Days)
[*]Fast: Pay more money for faster construction than incremental upgrading (e.g a Deluxe Barn costs 50,000g, same Wood and Stone, but only 5 Days).
[/list]
Supports the vanilla Big/Deluxe Coop/Barns, the Big Shed, as well as the following modded upgrade buildings:
[list]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21800?tab=description]Resource Chicken[/url]﻿'s Giant Coop[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25586]Jen's Mega Coops and Barns[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32527]Aquaponics[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33727]Gigantic Coops and Barns[/url]﻿  (as upgrades to Jen's Mega Coops and Barns)
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22524]Deluxe Shed[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22021]Dwarven Expansion[/url]'s Cave Coop Upgrades
[/list]
Thanks to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Scarlett28?gameId=1303]Scarlett[/url] for help on much of the compat!
Installation Instructions For Users:
[list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿ and the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32864]Carpentry Catalogue[/url]﻿.
[*]Download and extract the zip into the Mods folder inside the game's directory.
[/list]
